name: vm-manager-hyperv
description: Hyper-V provider for VM Manager: manage the Hyper-V virtual machines on this Windows machine, with an interactive console and a serial console in the editor.

vmManager.providers.description: Microsoft Hyper-V on this Windows machine

walkthroughs.title: Set up Hyper-V for VM Manager
walkthroughs.description: Make sure Hyper-V is enabled and your account may manage it.

steps.title: Enable Hyper-V
steps.description:
Hyper-V must be enabled as a Windows feature (Windows 10/11 Pro, Enterprise or Education, or Windows Server).
[Check Prerequisites](command:vmm.hyperv.checkPrerequisites)

steps.title: Add your local Hyper-V
steps.description:
Add a cluster of type Hyper-V. Your computer appears as its single node.
[Add Cluster](command:vmm.addCluster)
